dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single thin, high-contrast white horizontal band visible across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, pale bluish-grey boundaries along the outer vanes of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular oval white patch located centrally on the posterior nape, bordered by black.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and linear boundary between the black crown/nape and the olive-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-green wash on the upper mantle region immediately below the nape.
